evidence_levels.e2: plus real execution against production, proof committed
evidence_levels.e3: plus independently reproduced by a third party

integrations.name: LangChain

technology.name: LangChain
technology.what_it_is: The most widely used framework for composing LLM applications: chains, retrievers, agents and tools.

value.host_keeps: LangChain keeps orchestration, prompting, retrieval and whatever tracing stack you already run.
value.neomundi_adds: Signed, independently verifiable behavioural measurement of each LLM interaction -- five signals with explicit provenance and an explicit measured / not-measured state -- without writing a measurement call per call site.
typical_use: Detect a behavioural regression that latency, cost and error rate do not show.
Answer an audit with signed records instead of log lines you assert yourself.
Produce runtime inputs to an EU AI Act dossier, which cannot be retrofitted.

entrypoint.snippet:
handler = NeoMundiCallbackHandler(api_key=..., base_url="https://api.neomundi.io")
answer = chain.invoke(question, config={"callbacks": [handler]})
print(handler.last_outcome.request_id)  # your correlation key

refusals: The provider reports no token count, so nothing is submitted and nothing is estimated.
Your own LLM call failed, so there is no complete interaction to measure.
The measurement API is unreachable, so the failure is reported and your chain is untouched.
Sampling excluded the run, so no socket opens and nothing is billed.

billing.note: Every submitted observation is a billed measurement; there is no trace-only route. sample_rate defaults to 1.0, so read the cost section before pointing this at a busy application.

integrations.name: Langfuse

technology.name: Langfuse
technology.what_it_is: An open-source LLM observability platform: traces, prompts, cost, sessions, datasets and evaluation scores, self-hosted or in the cloud.

value.host_keeps: Langfuse keeps the trace: prompt, completion, latency, cost, sessions, datasets, experiments, and the UI the developer already has open.
value.neomundi_adds: Signed, independently verifiable behavioural measurement of the same interaction, written onto that Langfuse trace as scores -- one per signal the server declared measured -- with the NeoMundi request_id attached so the trace links to the signed record.
typical_use: See NeoMundi signals next to latency and cost on the trace you are already debugging.
Filter or chart Langfuse traces by a measured behavioural signal.
Jump from a Langfuse trace to the signed, third-party-verifiable NeoMundi record.

entrypoint.snippet:
bridge = NeoMundiLangfuseBridge(langfuse)  # your existing Langfuse client
outcome = bridge.write(trace.close())  # a neomundi TraceRecord or GovernResult
print(outcome.status, outcome.signals_written)

refusals: A signal the server did not declare measured gets no numeric score, not even its conventional value.
There is no Langfuse trace to attach to, so nothing is written.
A measurement that was not submitted writes only a summary saying so, never a signal.
A Langfuse or bridge failure is reported as an outcome and never reaches your application.

billing.note: The bridge never contacts NeoMundi and bills nothing by itself. The measurement it transports was billed when it was submitted, at 0.030 CHF per observation, by whatever produced it.
